notes: Phase D exploratory; no verdict. Rates are simultaneous non-coverage over 12 contrasts.
phase_c_assumptions: k ~ Binomial(n, 0.05) independently in 8 gated scenarios; pass iff one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson UB <= 0.06 - delta, delta = truth-region failure probability added (0 for exact or negligible truth error); conservative count assumed equal to the true rate (truth-region widening neglected); requirement P(all pass) >= 0.90. With delta = 0.01 (99% region of the protocol) a rule at exactly 5.0% cannot reach 0.90 for any n <= 40,000.
